recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The issue is already applied correctly in the current FHIR source and no follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-47334.
issue_request: FHIR-47334 was an Applied FHIR-I R6 change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to replace the confusing Subscription introduction sentence saying 'Subscriptions are active resources' with wording that explains Subscription resources represent server state, client changes are requests, servers SHOULD only accept requests they expect to honor, and a Subscription is active only when Subscription.status is active and the resource has not been deleted.
initial_application: Git commit b07c70a1cc371915c4901128dacb9850f776ecd9, 'FHIR-47334 - subscription active clarification', replaced the old paragraph in source/subscription/subscription-introduction.xml. The Jira comment linked HL7/fhir#3967, a merged R6 Tickets pull request whose description says each commit includes ticket information.
additional_context: Subscription is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/subscription/subscription-introduction.xml is build-scoped resource narrative. FHIR-I minutes for 2025-03-31 list FHIR-47334 in the Subscriptions block vote and record approval by Gino Canessa / Bas van den Heuvel at 17-0-0. Zulip searches found only the block-vote announcement for the exact key and no substantive conflicting discussion for the active-resource terms.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current combined-branch source already contains the approved replacement wording at source/subscription/subscription-introduction.xml:22-27, including code/link markup for Subscription.status, active, and SubscriptionTopic, and repository search found no remaining copy of the old 'Subscriptions are active resources' wording in source.
